title: Arista Networks Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 3.036 billion, GAAP diluted EPS was USD 0.95, and at June 30 cash and current marketable securities were USD 13.343 billion while non-cancellable purchase commitments were USD 9.7 billion.
summary: The current Q2 filing confirms revenue, earnings, cash generation, liquidity, inventory, purchase commitments, dilution, customer concentration and predominant Broadcom merchant-silicon reliance used in the full review.
